青音把右手伸到了她面前，不解地看着她。
就见陆昭菱的手轻轻覆到她的手上。
青音看着自己的手，瞳孔一缩。因为就在这一点时间内，她清清楚楚地看到自己的手掌手指上渐渐地浮现出一层灰黑色的粉尘。
但是她之前的手明明是洗得干干净净的！
而且她是眼睁睁看着这一层灰黑色从皮肤里渗出来的！
“去用艾草和石榴叶泡水，洗三遍。”陆昭菱说。
因为太急了，出门时差点儿撞到了青灵。
“青音，怎么冒冒失失的？”青灵吓了一跳。她们受庆嬷嬷教导，从来不会这么冒失，青音这是怎么回事？
她又看到了青音举着的手，“手怎么这么脏？”
青音声音都有点颤抖，“我，我先去洗手！”
她举着手，现在不洗干净她自己都做不了任何事了！
青灵见她急急地跑了出去，迷惑地进了门。
“手脏了而已。”陆昭菱弱弱地靠在床上，“有事？”
“奴婢准备好了热水，陆小姐要沐浴吗？”
而青音去了厨房讨要艾草和石榴叶却碰了壁。
“现在谁有功夫给你找这玩意？我们忙着呢！”
转头，她就对旁边的人嗤笑着说，“也不知道哪里来的两个野奴，自己就是侍候人的，还跑到咱们面前摆谱了，刚才那个才来烧了一大锅热水，这个又来要什么石榴叶。”
“就是，我们侍候府上正经主子就忙不过来了，还得给她俩办事，呸。”
青锋送她们过来的时候，是指了路让她们直接到听暖楼的，陆府的管家只知道青锋是晋王侍卫，但这两个丫鬟，他也摸不清楚，是晋王派来暂时监视陆昭菱的，还是暂时来照顾她的。
于是跟下人们就没怎么提，只说听暖楼那边暂时来两个外头的丫鬟。
这些在后厨的，还真不知道她们是晋王派来的。
“你们也可以告诉我在哪里摘石榴叶，我自己去摘。”青音说。
大周京城的人家，流行种石榴，因为石榴有多子多福的寓意。特别是家境好点的，达官贵人家的，更没少种。
艾草这种东西，一般府上也会备着些，夏日里下人们烧一烧赶赶蚊子，府上有夫人姑娘着凉了也可能用来煮水擦身。
“院子就这么大，自己去找呗，难道还要我们放下手头的活去给你摘？”仆妇说。
夫人和大小姐明显都不喜欢二小姐，那从乡下来的，能有什么地位？更何况这两个暂时来侍候她的。
“石榴叶我可以自己去摘，那艾草在哪里？”青音忍着气。

> Chapter 17 The spirit position has fallen (page 1)
Qingyin stretched out her right hand in front of her and looked at her puzzled.
She saw Lu Zhaoling's hand gently covering hers.
Qingyin looked at her hands and her pupils shrank. Because at this moment, she clearly saw a layer of gray-black dust gradually appearing on her palms and fingers.
But her hands were clearly washed before!
And she watched helplessly as this gray-black layer seeped out from her skin!
"Soak mugwort and pomegranate leaves in water and wash them three times." Lu Zhaoling said.
Because I was in a hurry, I almost bumped into Qing Ling when I went out.
"Qingyin, why are you so rash?" Qingling was startled. They were taught by Aunt Qing and would never be so reckless. What's going on with Qingyin?
She saw Qingyin's raised hand again, "Why are your hands so dirty?"
Qingyin's voice was trembling a little, "I, I'm going to wash my hands first!"
She raised her hands, now she couldn't do anything without washing them!
Seeing her running out in a hurry, Qing Ling entered the door in confusion.
"My hands are just dirty." Lu Zhaoling leaned weakly on the bed, "Is something wrong?"
"My servant has prepared the hot water. Do you want Miss Lu to take a bath?"
Qingyin went to the kitchen to ask for mugwort and pomegranate leaves but hit a wall.
"Who has time to find this thing for you now? We are busy!"
Turning around, she sneered at the people next to her and said, "I don't know where these two wild slaves came from. They are the waiters themselves, and they even came to show off in front of us. The one just came to boil a large pot of hot water, and this one came to ask for some pomegranate leaves."
"It's just that we are too busy serving the serious master of the house, and we have to do things for them, bah."
When Qing Feng sent them here, he pointed out the way for them to go directly to Tingnuan Building. The housekeeper of the Lu Mansion only knew that Qing Feng was the bodyguard of King Jin, but he couldn't figure out whether the two maids were sent by King Jin to temporarily monitor Lu Zhaoling or to take care of her temporarily.
So my followers didn't mention it much, except that two maids from outside were temporarily coming to Ting Nuan Lou.
These people in the kitchen really didn't know that they were sent by King Jin.
"You can also tell me where to pick pomegranate leaves, and I will pick them myself." Qingyin said.
It was popular among people in the capital city of the Great Zhou Dynasty to grow pomegranates, because pomegranates symbolize fertility and fertility. Especially those from better-off families and those from high-ranking officials and aristocratic families, even more so.
Generally, people would keep some mugwort in their houses. In summer, people would burn it to drive away mosquitoes. If a lady or girl in the house caught a cold, they might use it to boil water and wipe themselves.
"The yard is only so big. You can go find it yourself. Do you want us to put down what we are doing and pick it for you?" said the servant woman.
The madam and the eldest lady obviously don't like the second young lady, so what status can someone from the countryside have? What's more, these two are here to serve her temporarily.
"I can pick the pomegranate leaves myself, but where is the mugwort?" Qingyin held back her anger.
